title: BPW-2026-0533
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0533
CD ALL
TASK ORDER SOLICITATION (TOS) S-061 – CORDOBA CORPORATION
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation or designee to award TOS S-061 to Cordoba Corporation from the On-Call list;
APPROVE a total budget of $847,669.00 to fund the services. Cordoba will provide experienced experts to program and establish redundant communication fail over for the critical sites and provide unforeseen maintenance support; and
APPROVE the term of engagement beginning with the Notice-to-Proceed date for a contract period of 18 months.
(W.O.: SZC14328, S04IDYNC, C-145671)
